subject: added __attribute__((pure))
perf_evidence: Adds __attribute__((pure)) (XXH_PUREF) to hashing API declarations: a function attribute whose only purpose is to let compilers optimize calls (CSE/hoisting/dead-call elimination) - codegen intent; no message body.
change_summary: Defines XXH_PUREF (__attribute__((pure)) on GNUC) and adds it to the declarations of XXH32, XXH32_digest, XXH32_hashFromCanonical, XXH64, XXH64_digest, XXH64_hashFromCanonical, XXH3_64bits*, XXH3_128bits*, XXH128 etc. No function body changes.

units.name: library implementation (XXH_INLINE_ALL; XXH32/XXH64/XXH3/XXH128 one-shot, XXH32 streaming, hashFromCanonical)
units.evidence: IR identical for all 7 targets after normalization; Alive2 EQUIV both directions (XXH32 len20 (value args), XXH32 stream 10+10 (value args), XXH64 len40, XXH3_64bits len20/200(withSeed), XXH3_128bits len20, XXH64_hashFromCanonical)

units.name: separately compiled client calling the API twice (declarations only, library linked separately)
units.evidence: client IR differs (new: x - x folded to 0 since calls are pure/willreturn). Alive2 fwd 'Source and target don't have the same return domain' with example 'Source: function did not return!' - the CE needs the opaque extern XXH32 to not terminate / be impure, which the real implementation never does; Alive2 cannot check that the declaration contract is justified by the (separately compiled) implementation

notes: The commit only adds a declaration-level contract. (1) Implementation level: compiled with XXH_INLINE_ALL (bodies visible) the IR is identical on both sides (clang already infers the attributes it needs from the bodies) -> EQUIV; XXH32 targets take inputs by value (U8ARGS) to avoid the SSE4.1-guard freeze/poison timeout; --unroll 8 only because streaming finalize loops exist (identical IR). (2) The perf effect exists only for separately compiled callers: there Alive2 treats the undefined extern function as arbitrary (may diverge, may have side effects), so the reported 'counterexample' (old client calls a non-returning XXH32) is not realizable with the real library; whether 'pure' is truthful is a cross-TU property Alive2 cannot check -> UNSUPPORTED(other) for that unit. Commit verdict follows METHOD aggregation (an UNSUPPORTED unit, no NOT_EQUIV) -> UNSUPPORTED; library semantics unchanged (IR identical). Flags: default x86-64-v3 recipe + -DXXH_NO_INLINE_HINTS=1 -mllvm -inline-threshold=100000 (impl); client compiled with the default flags (no implementation).
